# Filter rows where the Name column contains "Naylor Rd Line"
naylor_rows = df[df['Name'].str.contains('Naylor Rd Line', case=False, na=False)]

# Extract the 'Major streets' column for these rows
major_streets = naylor_rows['Major streets'].dropna()

# Split the entries by newline to get individual streets, then flatten the list
all_streets = []
for entry in major_streets:
    # Split by newline and strip whitespace
    streets = [street.strip() for street in entry.split('\n') if street.strip()]
    all_streets.extend(streets)

# Count unique major streets
unique_streets = set(all_streets)
answer = len(unique_streets)
